snippet.title: The Closer: Game of the Year Edition Teaser Trailer
snippet.description: The Closer: Game of the Year Edition is an upcoming indie adventure game/walking simulator about baseball, failure, redemption, and pub trivia. For more information, check out www.redbirdmenace.com or the game's announcement at http://wp.me/pSRKA-Bm
